newsitem.title: USA: J.C. Penney sees Q1 same-store sales rising.
newsitem.headline: J.C. Penney sees Q1 same-store sales rising.

text.p: J.C. Penney Co Inc said Tuesday it projects comparable J.C. Penney stores sales for first quarter of 1997 to increase by a low to mid-single digit percentage.
It said comparable sales of its Eckerd Drugstores unit for the first quarter are projected to be strong and to increase in the high single-digit range.

The company issued the projection in its report for sales for the five weeks ended April 5. It said total sales for the entire company increased 36.5 percent to $2.54 billion from $1.86 billion in the comparable 1996 period.

Sales of J.C. Penney stores for the month decreased 2.6 percent to $1.29 billion from $1.33 billion in the 1996 period. On a comparable store basis, that is stores open at least a year, sales decreased 3.7 percent.
